sent.text: This may be an emergency. Call emergency services now: 911 in Uruguay, or your local emergency number. Or go to the emergency room, and tell your pediatrician. This is the public guidance of the American Academy of Pediatrics, not advice about your baby: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/health-issues/conditions/fever/Pages/When-to-Call-the-Pediatrician.aspx
